latin: Intellectualis natura, quae est in anima rationali supra naturam rationalem, praecise differt a natura intellectuali pura sicut differt pars a toto.
translation: The intellectual nature present in the rational soul above its rational nature stands to the pure intellectual nature exactly as a part stands to its whole.
